note:
R17 — gen7 music box table (`audio/music/music_musicboxdata.bin`, 'MBX0', big-endian) and its binding to the music bank
(`music_samples.sbr` SBKR ids). Header word 4 → (u32 record count, u32 first record offset). Record (36 B): u32 sample id | 5 × u32 1 | u32 category | u32 kind | u32 ptr → pair of
string pointers (a "VolumeType" label and a context name such as LoseGame / WinGame / EndOfPeriod). Read-only; PS3 loose files of
NHL 11 / 14 / 15 / Legacy. Usage: python r17_musicbox.py <out.json>
